outlet: Goldendale Sentinel, "Getting to know Klickitat County EMS District No. 1" part 7 (Katharina Larson and Suzanne Gilmer of KCEMS1, 2024-08-14)
notes: District-written feature column: three primary ambulances, one on-call and two back-ups; about $389,000 to put a new four-wheel-drive ambulance in service; retired ambulances passed to the 15 fire departments in the EMS district.
